description: Saves and publishes the banner for a website on the confirmed account: colours (for example the suggested banner colours from a site analysis), position, layout, font, privacy policy URL and, per language, the banner texts. The banner shows the language of the website's <html lang>; every supported language has built-in texts, so texts are only needed for the user's own wording. Returns a preview link to the CookiePilot panel.

colors.description: CSS colours (hex or rgb/rgba); missing keys keep their current value

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website added last (or given to create_account)

privacy_policy_url.description: Link to the site's privacy policy

texts.description: Banner texts by language code, e.g. {"pl": {"bannerTitle": "…"}}. Plain text only; missing keys keep their current (or built-in) wording; other languages are not changed.

name: configure_banner
title: Configure the cookie banner
